name: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Finds the length of the longest sequence of consecutive integers in O(n) time using a hash set.
aim: Find longest consecutive run [n, n+1, n+2, ...] by checking if each number is a sequence start (n-1 not in set), then extend.
howItWorks: Insert all numbers into a hash set
For each number n: if (n-1) not in set, n is start of a sequence
Count how many consecutive n+1, n+2, ... are in set

complexity.spaceDescription: Hash set stores all n elements

whenToUse: Unsorted array, need O(n) consecutive sequence
alternatives: Sort then scan — O(n log n) but simpler
